plan_title: Oxy South Plains Complex Subpart RR Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) Plan
ama_definition: The boundary of the 38-unit South Plains Complex plus a half-mile buffer, projected to hold the free-phase plume through the project and five years after injection (p19-21).
mma_definition: Same as the AMA; the stabilized plume is projected to stay inside the complex, to be confirmed with the reservoir model (p21).
leakage_pathways_rated_significant: Wellbores and surface equipment are treated as the only meaningful pathways; a risk table rates all eight pathways low in likelihood and magnitude (p22-28).
baseline_summary: No pre-injection environmental baseline. Existing automated operational data (injection set points from pattern surveillance, production forecasts, inspection work orders, H2S alarms) are used to flag excursions (p35-36, p42).
reporting_summary: Annual Subpart RR report filed by March 31; equipment leaks reported under Subpart W; records kept at least three years; well changes and expansions noted in the annual monitoring report; the discontinuation request is to include two to three or more years of post-injection data. No commitment to publish data or report to the state UIC program (p5, p35, p42-44).

rows.detail: Custody transfer meter on Bravo pipeline CO2 plus meters on sweet and sour recycled CO2 from the Mallet Plant, net of meters on CO2 sent to other EOR operations; flow measured continually, composition at least quarterly.
rows.location: Bravo custody transfer point (M1); Mallet Plant delivery and diversion meters (M2-M5, M11)
rows.evidence_quote: Flow rate is continually measured and will be reported on a quarterly basis.

rows.detail: Injection pressure monitored continually via SCADA against pattern plans programmed into WAG skids; operators notified of significant deviations; skids shut off automatically on overpressure; SCADA monitors wellhead pressure.
rows.location: Each injection well and WAG skid
rows.trigger_or_response: Deviation from set points: automatic flag, field investigation, work order; automatic shutoff if pressure exceeds programmed levels.
rows.evidence_quote: Pressure in injection wells is monitored on a continual basis using SCADA.

rows.detail: Annular pressure in wellheads monitored to detect tubing and casing leaks.
rows.trigger_or_response: Anomaly: inspect and repair; if extensive, well shut in, work order, leak quantified.
rows.evidence_quote: monitoring of the annular pressure in wellheads

rows.detail: MITs on injectors listed in the response plan as the check for tubing and casing leaks; no testing interval or rule citation given.
rows.trigger_or_response: Tubing or casing leak: well shut in, workover crews respond within days.
rows.evidence_quote: Monitor changes in tubing and annulus pressure; Mechanical Integrity Test (MIT) for injectors

rows.detail: Each producer tested about once every two months at one of 33 satellites (8-12 hours); produced gas sampled at least quarterly at the satellite outlet meters; results compared with forecast.
rows.location: Each production well; 33 satellite separation facilities
rows.trigger_or_response: Significant deviation from forecast: well management personnel investigate; work order if unresolved.
rows.evidence_quote: each well being tested approximately once every two months

rows.detail: Plan says Oxy routinely measures reservoir pressure for modeling and operations, read at WAG headers and in new wells; FPP from step-rate tests. Listed monitoring wells are not tied to this.
rows.location: Injection zone, via WAG headers and new wells
rows.trigger_or_response: Unexplained pressure changes: investigate; reseal abandoned wells, manage lease-line fluids, or shut in injectors.

rows.detail: Routine field inspections of wells and surface facilities for white CO2 clouds and ice; also used to spot unapproved drilling.
rows.trigger_or_response: Problem found: investigate, work order tracked to completion, leak quantified.
rows.evidence_quote: Field inspections are conducted on a routine basis by field personnel.

rows.detail: All field personnel wear H2S monitors (alarm at 10 ppm) as a proxy for CO2 leaks, though the plan says H2S in injected gas is below the analyzer's threshold.
rows.trigger_or_response: Alarm: protect personnel, investigate source, quantify CO2 leak for the annual report.
rows.evidence_quote: H2S monitors are worn by all field personnel.

rows.detail: Oxy participates in the public TexNet network and says it will keep monitoring for seismic signals; a 2023 USGS review (M3.0+) found none near the complex, nearest about 80 miles away. No site array.
rows.trigger_or_response: Seismic event: shut in nearby injectors, assess the reservoir and respond if needed.
rows.evidence_quote: will continue to monitor for seismic signals that could indicate the creation of potential leakage pathways in the South Plains Complex

rows.detail: 3D seismic acquired over the complex was analyzed (coherence attributes) to rule out faults in the storage complex; deeper Strawn faults mapped. No repeat seismic.
rows.evidence_quote: Oxy has analyzed 3D seismic data acquired over the South Plains Complex to assess potential leakage pathways.

rows.detail: Subpart W emission factors and engineering estimates used to quantify surface equipment leaks and vents, reconciled with event-driven estimates to avoid double counting.
rows.evidence_quote: Oxy uses 40 CFR Part §98 Subpart W to estimate the mass of CO2 emitted from surface equipment leaks and vented emissions

rows.detail: Pipeline leak detection: personnel monitor the pipeline system continuously through SCADA, backed by visual inspection.
rows.trigger_or_response: Leak detected: mitigate and quantify under Subpart W.
rows.evidence_quote: Personnel continuously monitor the pipeline system using SCADA and are able to detect and mitigate pipeline leaks expeditiously.

rows.detail: History-matched tNavigator compositional model tracks injected CO2; Oxy will use it to confirm plume containment, forecast lateral migration and pressure, and revise the AMA/MMA if results require.
rows.trigger_or_response: Modeling shows a change is needed: submit revised MRV plan; take operational action to control CO2 movement.
rows.evidence_quote: Oxy will use the history matched reservoir simulation model of the South Plains Complex CO2 injection (see Section 3.5) to confirm CO2 plume containment.

rows.detail: Risk table says pipelines and surface equipment are monitored for corrosion; no method, location or frequency is given.
rows.evidence_quote: Constructed with CO2-resistant materials and monitored for corrosion

notes: Covers 38 units in the Slaughter and Levelland fields, some operated by others ('OBO'); third-party operators also run water-curtain injection (p6, p13). Nine monitoring wells (1 active, 8 inactive) appear in the well tables (p15, Table 5) but the plan never says what they monitor, so they are not coded as above-zone or reservoir-pressure monitoring. Corrosion monitoring appears only in the risk table (coded other, mentioned_only). Characterization used 3D seismic, image logs and micro-resistivity tools; the logs are open-hole characterization, so cased_hole_logging is not_found. Producers are tested about every two months (no bimonthly value; coded periodic_unspecified). Start date conflicts: January 2024 in the introduction (p5) vs. January 1, 2025 in the schedule (p42). The plan notes H2S in injected gas is below analyzer threshold, which weakens the H2S-proxy approach. Pages 46-157 are the well list; figures are images.
